title: PowerShell regression: Exchange Online and Microsoft Graph assembly clash
message: ExchangeOnlineManagement 3.10.x and Microsoft.Graph 2.38.x can fail when authenticating in the same PowerShell 7 session. A temporary connection sequence is available.

title: Exchange Online: -Credential retirement moved to December 2026
message: Microsoft postponed the client-side removal of -Credential. The retirement now applies to Exchange Online PowerShell module releases starting in December 2026.

title: Nebula news feed is live
message: A new section has been enabled to highlight urgent changes, release notes, and internal KB updates.
